title: Theming

title: Theming
text: session$setCurrentTheme() swaps active bs_theme() runtime without page reload, makes easy let users flip light/dark variants named presets. bslibdash component attaches SCSS via bslib::bs_dependency_defer(), components automatically recompile new theme: Use pattern expose curated set presets (example, Bootswatch picker) - just build bs_theme() objects ahead time hand chosen one setCurrentTheme(). dark variant built bs_theme(bg = ..., fg = ..., primary = ...) rather bs_add_variables() brand theme former makes bslib rederive coherent palette (greys, borders, link colours, secondary/tertiary backgrounds) bg/fg, latter patches named variables. underlying mechanics, see ?bslib::bs_dependency_defer.
code: library(shiny) library(bslib) library(bslibdash)  themes <- list(   light = brand_bs_theme(),   dark  = bs_theme(     version = 5,     bg      = "#0B0F19",     fg      = "#E5E7EB",     primary = "#60A5FA"   ) )  ui <- dashboardPage(   title  = "Theme switcher",   header = dashboardHeader(     rightUi = radioButtons(       "mode", NULL,       choices = c("light", "dark"),       inline  = TRUE     )   ),   sidebar = dashboardSidebar(     sidebarMenu(       id = "sidebar",       menuItem("Overview", tabName = "overview", icon = icon("house"))     )   ),   body = dashboardBody(     fluidRow(       valueBox(1200, "Total sales",     icon = icon("graph-up"),             color = "success"),       valueBox(53,   "Open issues",     icon = icon("exclamation-triangle"), color = "warning"),       valueBox(8,    "Critical alerts", icon = icon("bell"),                 color = "danger")     ),     fluidRow(       infoBox(title = "CPU usage", value = "48%",               subtitle = "Average over last 5 min",               icon = icon("cpu"), color = "primary"),       infoBox(title = "Queue length", value = 17,               subtitle = "Waiting jobs",               icon = icon("inboxes"), color = "warning")     ),     fluidRow(       box(title = "Status", width = 6, status = "primary",           "All systems nominal."),       box(title = "Notes",  width = 6, status = "info",           collapsible = TRUE,           "Toggle between light and dark in the header to see the theme swap.")     )   ),   theme = themes$light )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   observeEvent(input$mode, {     session$setCurrentTheme(themes[[input$mode]])   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Create a card — box
text: ... Contents card. title Optional title. footer Optional footer. status Bootstrap status color applied card header background. Accepted values Bootstrap semantic names: "primary", "secondary", "success", "info", "warning", "danger", "light", "dark". Unlike valueBox() infoBox(), legacy shinydashboard color names (e.g. "aqua", "blue") supported . background Bootstrap status color applied entire card background. Accepts values status. set, full card surface coloured rather just header. width Width card. integer 1–12 treated Bootstrap grid columns card automatically wrapped shiny::column(), consistent valueBox() infoBox(). value (e.g. "300px") applied inline CSS width. Use NULL placing card inside existing column boxLayout(). height Card height. collapsible Whether card body can collapse. collapsed Whether card starts collapsed. closable Whether card can hidden. maximizable Whether card can displayed full-screen. icon Header icon tag icon name. label Header label content. id Id card created box(). action Action trigger. options List new options action = "update". session Shiny session.
